messages:
Morgan H: Heads-up — overnight cost spike, GPUs in us-west-2 jumped ~180 -> 240, billing +28% vs baseline. Spotted on fleet-cost dashboard at 03:12 UTC. Panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/fleet-capacity
Diego R: looking now. quick scan of autoscaler logs shows spillover events. suspect dashboard/alert query is mis-grouping by region
Priya S: Were any region-specific alerts firing? did we get notified?
infra-bot: [autoscaler] scaled cluster-prod-us-west-2 from 180 -> 240 nodes (trigger: resourcePressure)
Diego R: found the bug: Grafana panel/alert use `region` label but our node metrics expose `aws_region`. query used by panel: `sum by (region) (cluster_gpu_allocated{env="prod"})` so most nodes end up in an `unknown` bucket and autoscaler routing falls back to default us-west-2
Morgan H: ok that would explain the spillover and cost skew. dashboard blindspot -> bad routing decision
Priya S: quick mitigation steps? we should avoid more spins while we fix queries + autoscaler config
Diego R: plan: 1) update panel + alert rule to derive region from `aws_region` with label_replace 2) add a short-term cap on us-west-2 capacity 3) long-term: make autoscaler prefer `aws_region` metadata rather than dashboard labels
Diego R: suggested alert expr (small snippet):
```
expr: |
  sum by (region) (
    label_replace(cluster_gpu_allocated{env="prod"}, "region", "$1", "aws_region", "(.*)")
  ) < 50
```
Diego R: I'll open a PR to change the Grafana panel and the Prometheus alert rule. also will add a fallback label_replace layer in the query explorer
Morgan H: Runbook for now: 1) scale down noncritical experiments in us-west-2 (I kicked off preemptible scale-down) 2) apply quota cap on us-west-2 via quota-controller 3) update incident ticket + notify finance for cost triage
Priya S: I'll add an Alertmanager route to notify #eng-infra immediately if `region="unknown"` appears in the quota panel. also watching for any further autoscaler scale-outs
Diego R: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/grafana/pulls/1234 — updates panel query, alert rule, and includes notes about why we prefer `aws_region` over `region`. deploying in ~10m
infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-134 created by Morgan H (priority: P2)
Morgan H: good. after PR merges we should validate with a synthetic at scale and confirm autoscaler prefers nodes by `aws_region`. follow-up tomorrow to ensure we didn't miss any other panels. :thumbsup:
